title: Failure bits bounded by the sample exponent
statement: Let $\varepsilon,\delta$ be rational parameters in $(0,1/2]$. If the failure-bit count is $b=\lceil\log_2\lceil 2/\delta\rceil\rceil$ and the sample count is $N=\lceil 2b/\varepsilon^2\rceil$, then $b\leq N\varepsilon^2/2$.
